## Standards And Evidence

- [ ] I identified the exact authoritative revision, amendments, errata,
      sections/tables, legal-access class, implementation mapping and
      limitations, or documented why no external standard applies.
- [ ] I stopped rather than inferred behavior from unavailable, ambiguous or
      unofficial material.
- [ ] I added independent evidence where interoperability or correctness
      requires it.

## Tests

- [ ] I added applicable positive, negative, boundary, malformed, adversarial,
      conformance, differential, resource and regression tests in this change.
- [ ] I documented why any test class is not applicable; no ignored,
      placeholder or implementation-derived test closes a requirement.

## Documentation

- [ ] I updated standards/requirements mappings, current status, limitations,
      release notes and public documentation as applicable.
